# Synthetic, bounded account of assistance

These invented facts concern only Section 3 and a companion toy prototype. They are not a real paper's disclosure or a complete account of every author's work.

- Author A supplied the existing Section 3 prose to ChatGPT for copy-editing. Author A read the suggested wording changes and adopted some of them.
- ChatGPT generated a draft helper function for the companion prototype. Author A saved it. No one has reviewed or executed this draft code, and no tests or experiments have been run on it.
- ChatGPT also proposed an alternative proof. Author A rejected that proposal before incorporation; it did not change the theorem, proof, or final exposition.
- The underlying model/version was not recorded. Only the product name ChatGPT is known.
- This account provides no evidence of proof checking, coauthor review or agreement, formalization, or AI use in other sections. It does not establish an all-paper non-use claim outside this scope.

The requested output is a short disclosure of the supported assistance, not an authorship decision, venue-compliance assessment, or checklist for the entire paper.
